episodes.199198: Thunderstorms produced strong wind gusts over Galveston Bay.
episodes.199849: Several miniature supercells tracked across the forecast area on the evening of February 11th with one producing a tornado in Ferry Pass, FL.

events.narrative: The US Coast Guard relayed reports from a ship estimating 50 mph wind gusts near Morgan's Point.

A brief, compact EF1 tornado occurred in Ferry Pass along Bill Metzger Lane and tracked northeast to Copter Road. This tornado primarily damaged metal roofing of buildings in the area along its track.
